# Cody repository instructions

Follow the shared project instructions in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md).

For mechanical work, follow [the mechanical workflow](../spec/mechanical-workflow.md) and load the specialist skill for the earliest phase lacking current evidence through [.github/skills/](skills/). Do not jump from requirements to detailed CAD or bypass prerequisite gates when a specialist skill is invoked directly.

The discovery files forward to shared procedures in [.claude/skills/](../.claude/skills/). Read and follow those canonical skill bodies; do not copy their procedures into the discovery files.
